name: polaris_cli_task_entry

test_list.description: The explicit host TOML profile denies unknown fields before any model process starts.
Profile bytes are bounded before TOML parsing.
Existing absolute llama and S1 executable/model/ORT paths and matching llama BLAKE3 pins are accepted.
A model file changed after pin creation is rejected before process startup.
A missing local host asset is rejected before model access.
The non-UI task command accepts an explicit profile and task goal.
The result JSON contains only bounded execution, proof, privacy-coverage and new-session lifecycle metadata.
Ignored acceptance with explicitly supplied pinned host files exercises actual S1, llama, read-only frame authority and owner cleanup.

inputs.name: profile
inputs.description: Explicit trusted host configuration with bounded local process paths and a literal loopback model endpoint.

inputs.name: goal
inputs.description: One bounded untrusted task goal, masked by the configured S1 host before provider access.

output_description: Sanitized JSON-safe execution metadata and independent proof status, with runtime and kernel cleanup on every started-owner path.
